weakness: Terminated and transferred store employees keep POS access; POS accounts not tied to HR; shared vendor and register passwords never changed; reviews semiannual and exclude POS
source: P07 assessment (AC-2, PS-4 objectives); P03 G-033 (PCI DSS 8.2); P01 R-035
remediation_plan: Tie POS accounts to the HR feed; weekly terminated-user report until automated; quarterly reviews including POS manager and refund roles; rotate shared passwords at each departure
milestones: 2026-09-30 6 found accounts disabled; 2026-10-31 weekly report running; 2026-12-31 HR feed to POS live and first quarterly review

weakness: POS vendor and refrigeration contractor remote access is standing, shared, password-only, unapproved per session, and unrecorded
source: P07 assessment (AC-17, MA-4); P03 G-035 (PCI DSS 8.4); P01 R-006, R-008
remediation_plan: Named vendor accounts through the access broker with MFA, per-session approval, recording, and automatic termination; disable always-on contractor tool
milestones: 2026-10-15 POS vendor named accounts; 2026-11-15 POS vendor through the broker; 2026-12-31 refrigeration contractor through the broker

resources_required: Vault licensing (in privileged access budget); POS vendor change ($15,000)

weakness: Store staff have no yearly security or privacy refresher; no training when new AI tools were introduced
